run_tts_pipeline_hpu: run a text-to-speech pipeline on Habana Gaudi HPU using a pre-trained model
run_tts_with_hpu_graphs: run text-to-speech inference with HPU graphs enabled for better latency
run_tts_bf16_precision: run text-to-speech generation in bfloat16 precision on the HPU device
run_tts_batch_inference: run batch text-to-speech inference with configurable batch size and warmup iterations
run_tts_benchmark: benchmark text-to-speech generation latency using HabanaGenerationTime over multiple iterations
